text: Removed StencilMethod, StencilParallelism, StencilExecutionPolicy, and every inert policy parameter/overload. Reference and direct executors are now explicit sequential choices. Added a compile-time regression proving the placebo type is absent and updated the guide. Evidence: stencilJVM 22/22, stencilJS 20/20, prepared JVM allocation probes remain directAllocated=0 B and booleanAllocated=0 B, fmtCheck passed, docsCheck/19 mdoc files passed.
